sections.title: M.Arch Summer Workshop
sections.description: This is a non-credit course for entering Master of Architecture students. The course will cover digital modeling and workflow and will prepare students for techniques used in the Architecture program's 5000 and 6000 level design studios. Course enrollment is by permit only.
